archive_to.description: URL that a copy of each successfully delivered message is going to be posted to.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the domain was created in RFC1123 format

is_disabled.description: Indicates whether the domain is currently disabled

name.description: Fully qualified domain name registered with Mailgun

require_tls.description: If true Mailgun will only send messages over a TLS connection

skip_verification.description: If true Mailgun will not verify the certificate and hostname when setting up a TLS connection

smtp_login.description: SMTP login username for the domain, only present if the user provides an smtp_password. Use the Credentials API for SMTP credentials management

smtp_password.description: Optional SMTP password for the domain used for SMTP authentication

spam_action.description: Action to take when a message is flagged as spam. Options are disabled, tag, or block

subaccount_id.description: The subaccount ID the domain belongs to. This field is only present if the domain is associated with a subaccount

state.description: Current verification status of the domain

type.description: Classification of the domain. Possible values are custom or sandbox

tracking_host.description: Custom tracking host for the domain used for tracking opens and clicks if configured

use_automatic_sender_security.description: If true Mailgun manages DKIM key generation and DNS record configuration automatically

webhooks_redact_pii.description: If true Personally Identifiable Information (PII) will be redacted from the payload of any webhook posted for this domain

web_prefix.description: Subdomain prefix used for open and click tracking

wildcard.description: Indicates if the domain is a wildcard domain and can receive emails for any subdomain

disabled.description: Optional field containing additional details about the domain's disabled status if applicable

encrypt_incoming_message.description: If true incoming messages to this domain will be encrypted

message_ttl.description: Specifies the time-to-live (TTL) in seconds for retrieving both incoming and outgoing messages. The maximum TTL value is determined by your subscription plan
